pages.text: A linked body that dies becomes a corpse with your armour and inventory, and you wake up in your head. Nothing hurts a corpse. Only you, and those you trust (/headoffice trust add), may use it to open it.

$(l)Incident 0119: No Suture Kit$()$(br2)As the jar, use the corpse. A Suture Kit on you or among its things is used at once. With no kit, the corpse opens its inventory so you can craft one. No body at all: the Body Printer.
